title: Trim clause logs from 4 KB and cap Lean memory at 8 GB
summary: Clause logs are now trimmed by Z3's native proof trimmer from 4,096 characters instead of 1 MB, shrinking Lean certificates 3x to 45x on real QF_UF and QF_LIA inputs without moving the trust boundary. Every lean process the repository starts is now capped at 8 GB of memory.
